required_action: Where permitted run python tools/literature/install_magma.py --allow-download, then supply --home build/omics-magma. If unavailable/forbidden, skip dependent analyses and provide the pinned runtime on a permitted supported host. Preserve changed/unmanaged homes and failed attempts; choose a new destination after correcting the named cause. Scientific validation is separate from this version check.
upstream_terms: MAGMA1.10 source and binaries may not be redistributed or modified. This installer downloads original files directly into an ignored private build directory; no upstream binary/source is bundled in the JLinAlg JAR or repository. Cite de Leeuw et al.2015 doi:10.1371/journal.pcbi.1004219. Official page requests mailing-list subscription; this tool sends no email.
